rules.message: Never call pool.query('BEGIN') on a shared pg.Pool; check out a dedicated client via await pool.connect() with try/catch/finally { client.release() } (retrieve transactions-concurrency-and-idempotency).
keepWhen: Pool instance is a dedicated single-connection test harness (max: 1) isolating sequential statements in an integration test.
dropWhen: Match occurs inside a code comment, documentation string literal, or negative scanner test fixture.

rules.message: Sequential await pool.query/client.query inside a for loop causes N+1 roundtrips; batch with LEFT JOIN LATERAL, UNNEST, or ANY($1::uuid[]) (retrieve query-optimization-and-eliminating-n-plus-1).
keepWhen: Offline CLI migration, seed, or batch maintenance script intentionally throttling bounded sequential chunks outside HTTP request paths.
Each loop iteration executes heterogeneous administrative DDL that cannot be parameterized into a set-based SQL statement.
dropWhen: Loop iterates over a tiny fixed compile-time constant tuple (2-3 items) or seeds isolated rows in a test fixture.
